title: Five pens at the counter
description: Five teal pens on a shop counter with a tag reading ₹9.5 each and a bill slip asking 5 × ₹9.5, Total = ₹ ?.

title: Between ₹45 and ₹50
description: Three cards in a row read 5 × ₹9 = ₹45, then a highlighted 5 × ₹9.5 = ?, then 5 × ₹10 = ₹50, with less than signs between them.

title: Place values of 27.53
description: A place value chart with columns Tens, Ones, Tenths and Hundredths holding the digits 2, 7, 5 and 3, with a dot marking the decimal point between Ones and Tenths, under the number 27.53.

title: Moving the point left
description: Two rows: 123 ÷ 10 = 12.3 with one hop arrow to the left, and 12 ÷ 1000 = 0.012 with three hop arrows to the left and a highlighted zero.

title: Zeroes match decimal places
description: A three row table showing 37/10 = 3.7, 37/100 = 0.37 and 37/1000 = 0.037, with matching colours for the zeroes and the digits after the point, tagged 1, 2 and 3 places.

title: Five jumps of 9.5
description: A number line from 0 to 47.5 with five equal jumps of 9.5 landing at 9.5, 19, 28.5, 38 and 47.5, above the equation 95/10 × 5 = 475/10 = 47.5.

title: Quarters that make 2
description: Eight amber quarter pieces on the left equal two whole squares on the right, each made of four quarters, with the equations 0.25 × 8 = 200/100 = 2 and 2.5 × 0.4 = 100/100 = 1.

title: Area with decimal sides
description: A teal rectangle with sides 13.3 cm and 5.7 cm, holding the working 57/10 × 133/10 = 7581/100 and Area = 75.81 sq cm.

title: Three steps through fractions
description: Four boxes joined by arrows: 1.2 × 0.3, then 12/10 × 3/10, then 36/100, then 0.36, with the steps as fractions, multiply and as a decimal.

title: Tenths times tenths
description: A 10 by 10 grid with 3 teal columns and 4 amber rows overlapping in 12 reddish purple cells, beside 3/10 × 4/10 = 12/100 = 0.12 and 1 place + 1 place = 2 places.

title: Use the whole number product
description: 596 × 248 = 147808 above, an arrow down to 5.96 × 24.8 = 147.808, with tags 2 places, 1 place and 2 + 1 = 3 places.

title: Count the places
description: A vertical multiplication of 2.3 by 0.14 giving 0.322, with tags 1 place, 2 places and 1 + 2 = 3 places beside the rows.

title: Where does the product land?
description: Three number lines, each with two teal dots for the numbers multiplied and a purple dot for the product: 18 beyond 2.25 and 8, 2 between 0.25 and 8, and 0.2 below 0.25 and 0.8.

title: Three situations for a product
description: Three columns with coloured chips: two teal chips give 3.4 × 6.5 = 22.1, greater than both; two amber chips give 0.75 × 0.4 = 0.3, less than both; one of each gives 0.75 × 5 = 3.75, in between.

title: Predict before you multiply
description: A 2 by 2 table: between 0 and 1 with between 0 and 1 gives less than both, greater than 1 with greater than 1 gives greater than both, and the mixed cells say in between.

title: One ribbon, ten pieces
description: A 3.9 m teal ribbon cut into 10 pieces with one purple piece of 0.39 m, which is enlarged and cut into 10 smaller pieces of 0.039 m each.

title: The point hops left
labels: Move the point one place left for each zero
description: Four rows, 18.7, 1.87, 0.187 and 0.0187, with the digits 1, 8, 7 lined up and a purple decimal point hopping one place left for each ÷ 10, ÷ 100 and ÷ 1000.

title: Count the zeroes, then hop
description: The divisor 1000 with its three zeroes in purple, three arrows hopping the point of 45.2 to the left, the result 45.2 ÷ 1000 = 0.0452, and two unit facts below.

title: Grow the denominator to 100
description: 29/4 becomes 725/100 by multiplying top and bottom by 25, which equals 7.25; below, a 29 m ribbon is cut into 4 equal pieces of 7.25 m.

title: Only 2s and 5s make 10s
description: Chips show 10 as 2 × 5, 100 as 2 × 2 × 5 × 5 and 1000 as 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 5 × 5, beside a struck out chip labelled 3.

title: Fraction to decimal in three steps
description: Three boxes joined by arrows: 7/20, then 35/100 after multiplying top and bottom by 5, then 0.35.

title: Ones become Tenths
description: A place value chart showing the quotient 331.25 for 1325 ÷ 4, with arrows showing 1 One regrouped as 10 Tenths and 2 Tenths regrouped as 20 Hundredths.

title: 237 ÷ 8 by long division
description: A long division of 237 ÷ 8 = 29.625, with the 50 Tenths row and the quotient's decimal point highlighted in purple.

title: Sharing 9.5 kg of sugar
description: A sack labelled 9.5 kg with arrows to 4 equal bags each labelled 2.375 kg, and the line 9.5 ÷ 4 = 2.375.

title: The regrouping ladder
description: Four place boxes, Ones, Tenths, Hundredths and Thousandths, joined by arrows marked 1 = 10, with the first arrow highlighted where the decimal point goes in.

title: 126 km in 2.5 hours
description: A bar for 126 km split into two 1 hour parts of 50.4 km and a half hour part of 25.2 km, with 126 ÷ 2.5 = 50.4 km per hour.

title: Make the divisor whole
description: Two rows: 4.68 ÷ 1.3 becomes 46.8 ÷ 13 = 3.6 after multiplying both by 10, and 4.68 ÷ 0.13 becomes 468 ÷ 13 = 36 after multiplying both by 100.

title: Same quotient, new numbers
description: The fraction 7.2 over 0.08 becomes 720 over 8 by multiplying top and bottom by 100, equal to 90.

title: The remainder comes back
description: A long division of 10 ÷ 3 with quotient 3.333..., where each remainder is 1 and is circled in purple.

title: The remainder chain of 1 ÷ 7
description: A ring of remainders 1, 3, 2, 6, 4, 5 joined by arrows carrying the quotient digits 1, 4, 2, 8, 5, 7, above 1 ÷ 7 = 0.142857142857...

title: The magic number 142857
description: A ring of the digits 1, 4, 2, 8, 5, 7 beside the products of 142857 with 1 to 7, ending in 999999.

title: Ends or repeats?
description: A box saying watch the remainder branches to ends, with 1 ÷ 8 = 0.125, and repeats for ever, with 2 ÷ 3 = 0.666...

title: Smaller or bigger quotient
description: A number line with 128 in the middle, an arc ÷ 4 going left to 32 and an arc ÷ 0.4 going right to 320.

title: How many pieces fit?
labels: divisor less than 1, so quotient bigger than 2.4
description: A 2.4 m ribbon split into 8 equal pieces of 0.3 m, with 2.4 ÷ 0.3 = 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

title: The Earth is not back yet
description: The Sun with the Earth's orbit, a long arrow marked 365 days ending just short of the start, a small highlighted gap marked 0.2422 day, and the line 0.2422 × 100 = 24.22 days.

title: Four calendar years
description: A bar of four year blocks, 365, 365, 365 and 366, totalling 1461 days above a slightly shorter Earth bar of 1460.9688 days, with the 0.0312 day overhang marked.

title: Each rule gets closer
description: A number line from 365240 to 365250 with dots for each leap rule's total over 1000 years and a star for the Earth at 365242.2, nearest the 400th year rule's 365242.

title: The full leap year rule
description: A flow chart with three diamonds, divisible by 4, by 100 and by 400, leading to 366 day or 365 day result boxes.

title: Price of 1 gram
description: A 250 g pack at ₹40 and a 150 g pack at ₹27 with their per gram prices 0.16 and 0.18, the bigger pack ticked as cheaper.

title: Moving between units
description: A staircase of km, m, cm and mm with times 1000, 100 and 10 arrows going down and matching divide arrows going up, with the example 1.2 m = 120 cm.

title: One fact, three answers
description: The fact 45 × 12 = 540 at the top with arrows to 4.5 × 1.2 = 5.4, 0.45 × 12 = 5.4 and 54 ÷ 1.2 = 45.

title: Bigger or smaller?
description: A number line from 0 to 40 with a start at 20, a jump left to 10 for 20 × 0.5 and a jump right to 40 for 20 ÷ 0.5.

title: A tiny solved Hidato
description: A 3 by 3 Hidato grid filled 1 to 9 with a path joining consecutive numbers and the diagonal step from 3 to 4 highlighted.

title: Where can the next number go?
labels: 13 goes in one of these 8 cells
description: A 3 by 3 block with 12 in the middle and the 8 touching cells marked with question marks as places for 13.
